author: 한비트 주식회사
description: 판매자 서버(Rails · Sinatra 등)에서 쓰는 두 함수를 제공합니다: Standard Webhooks v1 서명 검증과 Ed25519 토큰 검증. 표준 라이브러리만 사용합니다.

author: Bellevue Kitchen Pros
description: Split a kitchen remodel budget across 12 line items (cabinets, labor, appliances, countertops, flooring and more), add sales tax, a contingency reserve and a permit allowance, or price a Cost vs Value preset. Integer-cent maths. Library + CLI, no dependencies.

author: Phoenix Concrete Contractors
description: Take-off math concrete contractors use before a pour: slab, driveway, patio, footing, column and steps volume with waste, cubic yards to order, 80/60/40 lb bag counts, rebar and mesh, a rough installed cost range and hot-weather pour advice. Library and CLI, no dependencies.
